segments.title: Hype Train Friday Freestyle
segments.notes: Hype Train delivers an extended freestyle rap over trap beats, acknowledging subs and bits while riffing on long-ass anatomy, snack orgies, and bodily fluids; Chet interrupts for a duet about nachos, fries, brownies, and fruit roll-ups.

segments.title: World News & Snapple Lady
segments.notes: Case covers Lebanon ceasefire talks with JD Vance in Pakistan, Iran victory declarations, Eric Swalwell sexual misconduct allegations, Snapple lady Wendy Kaufman sobriety, a UK executor who blew inheritance on horse semen, Eric Adams obtaining Albanian citizenship, and a chimpanzee civil war tease.

segments.title: Mega Man Fan Game: Case Blackwell Edition
segments.notes: Case plays a viewer-made Mega Man fangame starring himself (Mega-Case) rescuing Chet from evil robots; Kendelle and Crum attempt the game, Crum quits after one death; Case eventually beats the Woodman-style boss after extensive farming.

segments.title: Super Monkey Ball 2 with Brandon
segments.notes: Brandon (CryptoZeu$) calibrates his GameCube controller live, plays Super Monkey Ball 2 story mode as Dr. Bad Boon's monkey minions, then Monkey Target and Monkey Bowling minigames, while his mother yells through the wall about Pastor Joe, nipple cream, and vibrating rabbits.

segments.title: Sign-off & Newegg Event Announcement
segments.notes: Case and Kendelle wrap the broadcast, announce they will appear at a Newegg event Saturday with a Valorant influencer match, and raid an unspecified channel.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored the broadcast, played a fan-made Mega Man game for over an hour, and announced a Newegg event appearance with Kendelle.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the cold-open sign-on and confirmed the stream was live.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Commandeered the opening with a lengthy freestyle rap about long-ass anatomy and snack orgies, then duetted with Chet.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Interrupted Hype Train for a snack-themed duet rap and bantered during the news block.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Appeared as 'Slang' (J-L-L-O-N-G) during the news block, debated snack definitions and Snapchat bans for congresspeople.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Joined Case for the Mega Man fan game attempt and appeared in the sign-off announcing the Newegg event.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Briefly attempted the Mega Man fan game, quit after one death, and referenced a blood-covered hard drive from his fugue state.

characters.name: Brandon (CryptoZeu$)
characters.notes: gaming correspondent. Played Super Monkey Ball 2 story mode and minigames live while managing his mother's wall-shouting interruptions.

storylines.beat: Crum reveals a blood-covered hard drive from his 'fugue state' that whispers at night and has been plugged into studio computers, generating new files including a 'hell poster' of Crum [1:51:49, 1:53:52].

lore_notes.fact: Possesses a blood-covered hard drive from a 'fugue state' that whispers when he sleeps; plugged it into studio computers, causing new files to appear [1:51:49, 1:53:52].
A 'hell poster' of Crum exists and Case was searching for it during the broadcast [1:51:25].
Claims he made a bet with his placenta at birth to never shower [2:14:35].
Has a 'blinking condition' where light and loud noises trigger involuntary blinking [2:24:48].
Was homeschooled for two years due to a skin condition before leaving school entirely [2:28:14].
Scheduled to appear at a Newegg event Saturday with Kendelle; Case will be in background while Kendelle plays Valorant in an influencer match [2:42:50].

episode_summary: Case Blackwell's Friday broadcast opened with a marathon Hype Train freestyle, moved through a news block covering Middle East ceasefire talks and domestic scandals, then devoted the majority of airtime to a viewer-made Mega Man fangame starring Case himself — which he, Kendelle, and Crum attempted with mixed success. The show closed with gaming correspondent Brandon (CryptoZeu$) playing Super Monkey Ball 2 amid his mother's wall-shouting interruptions, before Case and Kendelle announced a Saturday Newegg event appearance.
